mentions.description: Bor is a Linux desktop policy management tool that unifies the configuration of different desktop components—dconf, Kconfig, polkit, Chrome, Firefox, and others—as policies. It is licensed under LGPL.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Bor - Linux Desktop policy management ( https://getbor.dev/ ).

In short, it unifies the configuration of different desktop components as policies ( dconf, Kconfig, polkit, Chrome, Firefox, etc.. . It's LGPL.
